(3) A quiz segment begins with a digital overlay showing three options (A, B, C) while the deity points at the camera and the man in the sweater looks confused and then relieved. (4) The man in the sweater is seen frantically trying to catch falling red envelopes (hongbao) and game cards from the sky, while visual effects like 'MISS' appear near him. (5) A small animated female figure in green appears on the man's shoulder as he closes his eyes in deep concentration or prayer. (6) The man successfully catches a large quantity of cards and envelopes, holding them up with a joyous expression alongside the deity who is now standing next to him.
